table.name: betfront
table.purpose: Football (soccer) match betting odds: one row per match, with bookmaker opening and closing 1X2 odds (home win / draw / away win) plus match metadata (teams, competition, country, kickoff time, season year). Likely complements the football_data table of match results for odds-based analysis. Rows span 2009-2013 across many leagues worldwide.

AWAY_CLOSING.name: away_team_closing_odds
AWAY_CLOSING.description: Decimal betting odds for the away team to win, at the closing (last pre-kickoff) price. Range ~1.07-56, median 3.66.

AWAY_OPENING.name: away_team_opening_odds
AWAY_OPENING.description: Decimal betting odds for the away team to win, at the opening (first posted) price.

COMPETION.name: competition
COMPETION.description: League/competition identifier and season, e.g. 'primera-division-2011-2012', 'euro-2012'. Misspelled 'COMPETION' in schema.

COUNTRY.name: country
COUNTRY.description: Country (or region, e.g. 'europe', 'world') of the competition.

DATETIME.name: kickoff_datetime
DATETIME.description: Match kickoff date and time (2009-02-11 to 2013-02-27).

DRAW_CLOSING.name: draw_closing_odds
DRAW_CLOSING.description: Decimal betting odds for a draw, at the closing price. Median ~3.57.

DRAW_OPENING.name: draw_opening_odds
DRAW_OPENING.description: Decimal betting odds for a draw, at the opening price.

HOME_CLOSING.name: home_team_closing_odds
HOME_CLOSING.description: Decimal betting odds for the home team to win, at the closing price. Median ~2.17.

HOME_OPENING.name: home_team_opening_odds
HOME_OPENING.description: Decimal betting odds for the home team to win, at the opening price.

MATCH.name: match_teams
MATCH.description: Matchup as 'Home Team - Away Team' text, e.g. 'Grasshoppers - Basel'. Not unique (repeated fixtures across seasons).

table.name: football_data
table.purpose: Match results and pre-match betting odds for association football (soccer) matches across many countries, leagues and seasons (2000-2020). One row per match. Structure matches the classic Football-Data.co.uk dataset: full-time and half-time scores/results plus closing(?) odds from several bookmakers (Bet365, Bet&Win, Ladbrokes, Pinnacle).

AwayTeam.name: away_team
AwayTeam.description: Name of the visiting (away) team. Empty string appears 1046 times, likely missing data encoded as blank.

B365A.name: bet365_away_win_odds
B365A.description: Bet365 decimal odds for an away-team win. Null when odds unavailable (older seasons).

B365D.name: bet365_draw_odds
B365D.description: Bet365 decimal odds for a draw.

B365H.name: bet365_home_win_odds
B365H.description: Bet365 decimal odds for a home-team win. Min 0.0 is suspicious (odds must be >=1), likely a data error.

BWA.name: betwin_away_win_odds
BWA.description: Bet&Win (BWin) decimal odds for an away-team win.

BWD.name: betwin_draw_odds
BWD.description: Bet&Win (BWin) decimal odds for a draw.

BWH.name: betwin_home_win_odds
BWH.description: Bet&Win (BWin) decimal odds for a home-team win.

Country.name: country
Country.description: Country in which the league/match takes place (e.g. England, Spain, Turkey).

Datetime.name: match_datetime
Datetime.description: Kick-off date and time of the match (2000-2020). Many rows have 00:00:00 time, i.e. date only.

Div.name: division_code
Div.description: League division code (Football-Data.co.uk style), e.g. E0/E1/E2/E3/EC for English tiers, SP1/SP2 Spain, I1 Italy, D2 Germany, T1 Turkey.

FTAG.name: full_time_away_goals
FTAG.description: Goals scored by the away team at full time (0-9).

FTHG.name: full_time_home_goals
FTHG.description: Goals scored by the home team at full time (0-10).

FTR.name: full_time_result
FTR.description: Full-time result: H = home win, A = away win, D = draw. Four rows are empty (missing).

HTAG.name: half_time_away_goals
HTAG.description: Goals scored by the away team at half time. Value -1 (34208 rows) is a sentinel for 'not recorded', not a real score.

HTHG.name: half_time_home_goals
HTHG.description: Goals scored by the home team at half time. Value -1 (34208 rows) is a sentinel for 'not recorded'.

HTR.name: half_time_result
HTR.description: Half-time result: H = home lead, A = away lead, D = level. Null when half-time data missing (matches the -1 HT score rows).

HomeTeam.name: home_team
HomeTeam.description: Name of the home team. Empty string appears 1046 times, likely missing data encoded as blank.

LBA.name: ladbrokes_away_win_odds
LBA.description: Ladbrokes decimal odds for an away-team win.

LBD.name: ladbrokes_draw_odds
LBD.description: Ladbrokes decimal odds for a draw.

LBH.name: ladbrokes_home_win_odds
LBH.description: Ladbrokes decimal odds for a home-team win.

League.name: league_name
League.description: Human-readable league name corresponding to Div (e.g. E0 = Premier League, D2 = Bundesliga 2).

PSA.name: pinnacle_away_win_odds
PSA.description: Pinnacle decimal odds for an away-team win. Only available for later seasons (66% null).

PSD.name: pinnacle_draw_odds
PSD.description: Pinnacle decimal odds for a draw.

PSH.name: pinnacle_home_win_odds
PSH.description: Pinnacle decimal odds for a home-team win.

Referee.name: referee_name
Referee.description: Name of the match referee (e.g. 'M Dean'). Mostly null; only populated for some leagues/seasons. Formats vary ('Last First', 'Last, F.').

Season.name: season
Season.description: Season the match belongs to, usually in 'YYYY/YYYY' format spanning two calendar years; some rows use a single year (e.g. '2012', '2020').
